verdict.rationale: Galileo explicitly supports building datasets from production/live traces (galileo-docs-11), capturing traces/spans in production (galileo-docs-6, galileo-docs-7), and running offline evaluations/experiments against datasets with custom or LLM-as-judge metrics (galileo-docs-2, galileo-docs-8). This directly covers curating datasets from production traces and running offline evals. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the full production-trace-to-dataset-to-experiment workflow beyond vendor docs.
